evidence.title: Jitter · A fast and simple motion design tool on the web

name: Jitter
summary: Browser-based motion design tool: animate designs or AI-generated effects and export video, GIF or Lottie.
description: A collaborative motion design tool on the web used by 20,000+ creative teams. Import designs from Figma, animate on an infinite canvas with AI effects, use free templates for text, icons, UI elements and social media, then export to 4K video, GIF or Lottie.
contains: free templates for text, icons, UI elements, social media, video titles, ads, branding, websites and backgrounds
AI effects and image-to-video from a prompt
exports: 4K/120fps video, GIF, Lottie, ProRes and WebM
animated components, batch export, magic import and auto-resize/translate
shared workspace with collaboration and approval flows
